proposal.text:
Found and fixed it: Fort was checking an old feature name, while Codex reports the newer name. The safety check now recognizes the correct name and still requires the feature to be disabled. All 53 offline tests passed.

The real chat flow still needs testing. May I run one more five-minute attempt with automatic pairing, the same OpenAI settings and sample messages, and cleanup afterward?

preparationAuthority: Prepare a separate third-attempt record/path, minimal controller wiring, focused nonlive tests, exact pins and launch instructions. Do not start live runtime in this owner task.

scope.pairing: Automatic local UI pairing by the designated operator; enrollment values remain in CUA runtime variables and never enter chat/screenshots.
scope.preflight: Retain canonical explicit-false feature observations and all other existing strict controls.
scope.cleanup: Same exact scoped authorization/Keychain cleanup, owned-process disposal and native exit/pending checks.

preservation: Both consumed attempt records and ledgers remain byte-identical; no reset, reuse or relabeling.
excluded: relaxed checks, changed model/settings or provider fallback
new sign-in or provider credential copying
provider cleanup, deployment, public ingress or permanent services
